Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate the $l$ term, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}5{a}_{1}+l{a}_{2} & =b \\ 5[\begin{aligned}9 \\ -2 \\ 0 \\ 7\end{aligned}]+l[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5 \\ -2 \\ 8\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}45 \\ -20 \\ 4 \\ 19\end{aligned}] \\ l[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5 \\ -2 \\ 8\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}45 \\ -20 \\ 4 \\ 19\end{aligned}]-5[\begin{aligned}9 \\ -2 \\ 0 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ l[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5 \\ -2 \\ 8\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -10 \\ 4 \\ -16\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From the final equation above, we can tell that $l=-2.$
